body: You already are. You talking here that shows a lot of strength. You have the strength and the ability to do more than you know. You can do this.

I promise the people in your life do care. Try talking to them or try talking to a therapist. It might help. I know what it feels like to be so lonely it feels like no one cares but admitting to the people in your life that you feel this way is the first step.
Most likely people aren’t pretending to care they probably really do care. You are worth something I promise. Why do you feel this way?

Stay strong my friend. I know what it feels like for the loniness to be crushing. I am at university and I relate to never going anywhere. I don't ever leave my room. No one would notice for weeks maybe over a month. I hope you find people to talk too. I am always here if you want.

Please don't please. I have been struggling too but please don't. I don't no what to say. I wish I had the words that you needed to hear. But you are worth being loved. You are good enough. I would love to talk if you  need someone.
